How To Play

The Circuit has glitched and Junction Bay's signals are in chaos. Guide Go, Stop and Again through three districts, recover the three Circuit Keys, then enter the Gridlock to face The Static.

Each signal has a power tied to their nature — some paths only open for the right one of them. Switch freely with 1 / 2 / 3. Move with WASD or arrows, swing with Space, unleash your special with E, talk to folks with F, and drink a potion with H. Pause any time with Esc to save your progress.
